name: dealndone2025
description: Deal n Done POS System with Automated Recovery

scripts.backup:list: node -e "const ABS = require('./automated-backup-system'); const abs = new ABS(); console.log(JSON.stringify(abs.getAvailableBackups(), null, 2));"
scripts.backup:restore: node -e "const ABS = require('./automated-backup-system'); const abs = new ABS(); abs.restoreFromBackup(process.argv[2] || 'latest');"
scripts.git:commit: node -e "const GRS = require('./git-recovery-system'); new GRS().createRecoveryPoint('Manual backup');"
scripts.ai:status: node -e "const AI = require('./ai-recovery-dashboard'); const ai = new AI(); console.log(JSON.stringify(ai.getDashboardStatus(), null, 2));"
scripts.ai:stats: node -e "const AI = require('./ai-recovery-dashboard'); const ai = new AI(); console.log(JSON.stringify(ai.getRecoveryStatistics(), null, 2));"
scripts.emergency-backup: npm run backup:create && npm run git:commit
scripts.emergency-recovery: npm run backup:restore && npm run git:rollback
scripts.recover:search: node -e "const ERS = require('./enhanced-recovery-system'); new ERS().searchRecoveryPoints(process.argv[2] || '').then(results => { console.log(JSON.stringify(results, null, 2)); });"
scripts.recover:create: node -e "const ERS = require('./enhanced-recovery-system'); new ERS().createRecoveryPoint(process.argv[2] || 'custom-point', process.argv[3] || 'Custom recovery point');"
scripts.verify-files: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const criticalFiles = ['frontend/src/App.jsx', 'frontend/src/components/Sidebar.jsx', 'frontend/src/components/Header.jsx']; criticalFiles.forEach(file => { if (fs.existsSync(file)) { console.log('✅ ' + file); } else { console.log('❌ ' + file); } });"
scripts.setup:recovery: npm install chokidar && npm run backup:start & npm run git:start & npm run ai:start
scripts.setup:backup: npm install chokidar && npm run backup:start

author: Deal n Done Team
